verdict.rationale: Gladia is an API-first transcription service. First-party docs describe a public API for both async and real-time transcription, with request parameters such as `model` and custom_vocabulary_config, a live-session init call returning a connectable URL, and quickstarts, and the docs are agent-readable via llms.txt and .md endpoints. missing for 10: a publicly discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
